worldId: uint32 via b3StoreWorldId; never a pointer
bodyShapeId: two uint32 words [low, high] via official b3Store/Load ID helpers; never JS Number packed

statuses.14: WORLD_NONEMPTY: read-only trim skip; no mutation
statuses.15: IDENTITY_EXHAUSTED: no identity reuse; step may fault and only teardown is guaranteed
statuses.16: TRIM_UNSAFE: empty-storage preflight refusal; no mutation

lifetime: All returned JS snapshots own copied data. No borrowed native view may cross a public call. Caller-owned scratch storage is allocated per facade; heap views are reacquired after every native call.
excluded: proven same-epoch contact world/local reconstruction, full C21 and transient-sensor C22 acceptance
Hinge/P2P/other joints; Fixed native bridge is candidate, not T17 acceptance

bodyTransformBatch.input: count body IDs, two uint32 words each; every ID/world validated before any output write

eventSnapshot.unit: 32-bit words; float fields copied by memcpy, uint32 identity words unchanged
eventSnapshot.lifetime: C17 call copies current native arrays; facade step copies immediately before returning. Frozen JS snapshot repeats without consuming events and never borrows HEAP views. End IDs may already be invalid.

contactSnapshot.collection: Public b3Body_GetContactData touching contacts for facade-owned bodies, deduplicated by full contact ID; includes sleeping pairs, not just begin/hit events. Native contact/manifold pointers never escape a C call.
contactSnapshot.anchorEpoch: UNRESOLVED_CACHED_NATIVE: pre/post poses are diagnostics, NOT an asserted anchor basis. Recycling retains earlier anchors while updating separation.
contactSnapshot.worldLocalPoints: Explicit AIR_E_BOX3D_UNSUPPORTED_SNAPSHOT_EPOCH; native hit point is a separate raw event field, not general C21 worldPoint.
contactSnapshot.handleLifetime: Opaque facade WeakMap capability scoped to world+successful step+mutation revision. Next step, successful mutation, disposal or foreign token rejects. Returned frozen data remains unchanged.

additiveSnapshotScope: Existing ABI-1 wire/signatures retained. New schema hash must match facade/runtime; old e schema is not accepted by this facade.

contactGeometry.epoch: Actual b3UpdateContact completed generation, after flip/COM adjustment, before solve increments native stepIndex. Recycle/sleep/solve/CCD retain it. Not a current intersection or TOI point.
unqualifiedFamilies: arbitrary convex hull feature qualification beyond public Box
contactGeometry.lifetime: Read immediately into independent JS storage associated with the matching raw contact/full ID/world lifetime/step/mutation revision. Missing basis or unsupported family gives explicit error, never empty success.
contactGeometry.solverObservations: Raw separation/normalVelocity/impulses retain separate native sampling semantics; no same-epoch claim.
contactGeometry.nativeSnapshotCompatibility: b3Contact stride changes; native layoutHash incompatible with previous snapshots. No AIR replay claim.
contactGeometry.revisionExhaustion: When an additional generation would wrap UINT64_MAX, geometry is permanently unavailable for that contact lifetime; physics continues unchanged. Contact slot allocation zeroes all geometry storage and advances full contact ID generation.
publicDescriptorCandidates: Capsule-Capsule, including one exact-zero segment represented by a native sphere
contactGeometry.qualificationBoundary: Native AVAILABLE means copied cached-generation basis exists, not whole-family numerical qualification. Native hull includes arbitrary convex Hull, but public events only admit exact Box/Sphere/Capsule descriptors. Runtime compound is per-shape; baked compound excluded. Finite analytic and EX09 descriptor oracles are separate evidence; no formal T15/C21/Gate claim. Sphere-Capsule uses independent finite closest-segment generation cases; AVAILABLE alone is not whole-family/public callback qualification.

worldBridge.gravity: copied float32 xyz; finite validation before native mutation
worldBridge.sleeping: exact boolean; disabling calls real b3World_EnableSleeping and wakes sleeping solver sets
worldBridge.material: exact-world shape token; finite nonnegative friction/restitution, both validated before writes; compound rejected

stepDiagnostics.nativeStepIndex: safe JS integer count of confirmed successful native step calls; distinct from core generationStep; exhaustion rejected before invocation
stepDiagnostics.nativeCompleted: last admitted native attempt returned success; prevalidation rejection preserves previous record
stepDiagnostics.snapshotAvailable: false after mutation or copy failure; native success increments index even when subsequent copy fails
stepDiagnostics.dt: must remain positive finite after float32 conversion; underflow to zero rejected before native attempt and preserves previous diagnostics

debug.unsupported: CONSTRAINT and unknown bits fail before capture; unsupported shape callback returns error, never empty success
debug.jointScale: finite nonnegative float32 validated and echoed; no effect on available shape/AABB geometry, no joint qualification
debug.sphere: three orthogonal 24-segment great-circle wireframes from copied native local sphere
debug.hull: One line per native half-edge twin pair; up to 256 half-edges / 128 full edges. Arbitrary cooked hull source integrated; execution qualification pending.
debug.bounds: real core fat broadphase AABB callback, not exact shape local extents
debug.ownership: per-world copied local geometry handles owned until real core destroy callback; temporary capture buffer explicitly released in facade finally; no borrowed heap view or pointer escapes
debug.drawingBounds: finite float32 full range; no default +/-100 clipping
debug.capsule: Candidate: two 24-segment end rings, four cylinder generators and four 12-segment outward hemisphere arcs, 100 surface lines total; exact zero-segment shape uses native sphere callback.

memory: liveBytes.uint64 of bridge context/callback copies/capture capacity only
worldBridge.memoryScope: facade sums its owned worlds only; separate from core byteCount, JS objects and entire WASM heap capacity

bodyControls.forceOffset: relative to COM; local mode rotates vector and relative offset by body rotation; never body origin
bodyControls.ownership: Exact facade world/body capabilities plus native full generation/world ID and unlocked validation. Copied deep-frozen 49-float state; existing 29-float bodySnapshot unchanged.
bodyControls.privateLayout: Strict staged fixed-core body.h and physics_world.h. Actual sleepTime/sleepVelocity read; actual bodySim.force/torque clear. No persistent private pointer or added native allocation.
bodyControls.sleepy: enabled awake nonstatic, world/body sleep enabled, actual sleepTime > 0; last-step observation, not speed inference; no <0.5 cutoff
bodyControls.mass: Positive finite total mass. Relative solid geometry density weights; sensor-only fallback explicitly reported. No geometry pending until enabled dynamic step preflight rejects. Shape/type/lock operations restore requested mass.
bodyControls.massVelocityRule: Geometry/mass changes preserve body origin, COM linear velocity and angular velocity, not momentum; locks zero locked components. Static/disabled transitions use native state semantics.
bodyControls.strictBoolean: All new booleans and createBody.enableSleep reject numbers/strings/null before native mutation.
bodyControls.qualificationScope: Finite box/sphere only; arbitrary hull, mesh/compound, replay, full CCD/T10/G1 not implied.
bodyControls.motionLocks: Immediate world-axis velocity constraints: velocity setters and successful linear/angular impulses mask locked components before readback. Real force/torque accumulators remain pending until native solve. Legacy facade velocity/center-impulse methods route through these checks; C signatures unchanged.
bodyControls.boxMinimumHalfExtent: Each half extent must be >= 0.2f * B3_LINEAR_SLOP (0.001m in this pinned core). Reject smaller values before core helper silently enlarges them; applies both legacy and additive box facade/native creation.

capsuleCreation.operation: air_b3_mass_shape_create kind=2; no new export; schema identity changes
capsuleCreation.zero: Exact zero segment explicitly creates actual sphere geometry and sphere mass
capsuleCreation.shortPositive: Actual float32 endpoint squared distance <= B3_LINEAR_SLOP squared returns UNSUPPORTED before creation. No clamping or sphere fallback for positive segment.
capsuleCreation.preflight: Finite derived endpoints/mass/COM/inertia/transformed AABB/extents; requested-mass plan or native density-based added-first aggregation validated before native create.
capsuleCreation.replacement: Old shape is retained until new candidate is successfully created. Native or JS post-create failure is not described as rollback.
capsuleCreation.scope: Capsule creation/mass/motion/command and debug source support only; capsule contact snapshot, full EX01 family acceptance, browser and formal Gates remain unqualified.

shapeFilters.batchInput: count consecutive low/high uint32 full shape IDs; maximum4096; output must not overlap input
shapeFilters.batchOutput: count consecutive 2-word native readbacks; all admission precedes mutation/output writes
shapeFilters.inputDomain: signed32 or uint32 integer bitset; normalize >>>0 then zero-extend native uint64; groupIndex always0
shapeFilters.unsupportedNativeRead: nonzero upper32 category/mask or nonzero groupIndex fails without truncation
shapeFilters.contactTiming: invokeContacts=true; current snapshot invalidated only after success; real new contact/sensor observations on next step, retained snapshots immutable
shapeFilters.ownership: full-generation IDs, exact world, unlocked, whole batch validation, duplicates rejected, capacity checked; no persistent allocation or exposed pointer

mutationOutcome.scope: reviewed body controls/mass/force and legacy velocity/center impulse plus filter setters only plus motion apply/known validation rejection; pure validation unknown throw remains unannotated without snapshot invalidation
mutationOutcome.not-mutated: known admission failure including native nonzero status before any mutation
mutationOutcome.committed: native mutator returned0 including post-call readback failure; not a numerical-change claim
mutationOutcome.unknown: missing property on native throw/trap or unreviewed path; reviewed native-call exceptions conservatively invalidate current snapshot without changing step count; never inferred from error code
mutationOutcome.descriptor: optional readonly nonconfigurable enumerable property on Error

outputLayout: native angular cap; 0 if fast rotation
motionBatch.admission: Exact facade capabilities plus native full-ID/world/lock checks, duplicate body rejection, exact input word count, output capacity/nonoverlap, normalized quaternion, finite derived COM/inertia/AABB/dt/velocity. All records planned before first mutation; apply revalidates independently of earlier validate. No pending command ownership in native.
motionBatch.reset: teleport dynamic/kinematic including disabled; scene static only; preserveVelocity false and wake true defaults; disabled stays disabled and does not wake; forces/torques preserved
motionBatch.target: Enabled kinematic only; approximate fixed-core target COM/quaternion-difference formula. Actual damping unchanged, no SetTransform correction. Nonzero admitted motion wakes below sleep threshold; stationary target/clear zero both velocities without unnecessary wake. Target uses post-reset origin/COM when same record has reset.

limits.speedAdmission: nonzero velocity rejects magnitude >= cap-margin before damping and before lock residue projection; exactly zero velocity is admitted for any valid native positive cap, even cap < margin; angular cap omitted only for actual native allowFastRotation
limits.substeps: AIR integer 1, 2, 4 or 8; float32 dt/h/inv_dt/inv_h and 2*inv_dt finite, dt/h positive; this is a subset of legacy foundation.step positive-int32 admission

motionBatch.unusedPoseWords: canonical uint32 zero; no NaN/negative-zero hidden in unused fields
motionBatch.emptyBatch: world/dt/substeps validated, no mutation or snapshot invalidation
motionBatch.memory: Native plans allocated/freed through per-world owned bridge scratch, including allocation header, and included in bridgeMemory during the call; all known exits free scratch. World destruction reclaims tracked orphan scratch if teardown remains possible after unknown failure; no universal cleanup claim for corrupted/locked core. Facade input/output temporary buffers freed in finally. No persistent plan/pointer. Allocator capacity need not shrink.
motionBatch.phases: validate never invalidates snapshot or consumes intent, even on unknown validation status-delivery throw. Empty apply is likewise nonmutating. Nonempty apply status zero then copy/readback failure=committed; native throw/trap=unknown and invalidates current observation; known nonzero status=not-mutated. No rollback claim after unknown partial apply.
motionBatch.scope: Internal foundation candidate only, not public target lifetime/queue/Node synchronization or completed T11.

commandBatch.sequence: User safe integer1..2^53-1 increasing in packet; flagged internal scene/idle/cleanup0; native does not de-duplicate packets
commandBatch.arithmetic: Pure complete stream, strict fixed-core float helper order; no sorting/summing impulses. RESET updates shadow origin/COM/world inverse inertia, TARGET changes velocities only. Each operation has copied actual observations.
commandBatch.ownership: Full world/generation plus facade capabilities; preallocated tracked native scratch; input/output no overlap; no pointer or persistent plan escapes. Wake may affect bodies outside table.
commandBatch.mutationPhase: Only statuses1,2,4,5,8,9,10,11,12 from this export prove prewrite refusal. Nonempty apply0 means committed before copy; other status/throw unknown. Validate/empty delivery throws do not invalidate observations.
commandBatch.empty: Valid header/dt/N, NULL/0 output; no invalidation or native step increment
commandBatch.legacy: ABI1 and all earlier wire layouts unchanged; new schema required; patch chain unchanged

rayQuery.call: world, input, group.u32, mask.u32, queryTrigger.bool-int, outWords, capacityWords, countOut
rayQuery.collector: b3World_CastRay generic callback; no clipping; sensors ignored before collection when queryTrigger=false; fraction in [0,1); zero fraction/normal retained
rayQuery.capacity: NULL output and zero capacity sizes hits; copied output requires complete capacity. Count pass before writes, no native allocation, no persistent state. Invalid/capacity admission leaves output/count unchanged.
rayQuery.filter: signed32 or unsigned32 facade bitsets normalized >>>0, zero-extended to native uint64; bilateral category/mask semantics
rayQuery.zero: Zero float32 translation or zero group/mask returns empty without core cast; facade avoids native ABI call too
rayQuery.ownership: Exact unlocked world, full-generation copied shape observations, not ownership tokens; copied immutable arrays, no linear-memory views
rayQuery.adapter: Owns input normalization/maxDistance, logicalColliderID lookup, nearest-per-collider dedup and distance/logicalID sort; both all and closest use this same result stream
rayQuery.legacy: Legacy rayClosest and ABI1 unchanged. New schema requires a new module; not compatible with N4 and not a promotion.

hullCooking.input: Exactly 3*N finite float32 body-local XYZ positions. N>=4, checked N*3 and N*sizeof(b3Vec3). No raw count 128 cap. Convex envelope, not triangle mesh.
hullCooking.output: Two uint32 full shape ID words; unchanged on all known prewrite refusals.

limits.workspace: Exact checked actual private sizeof arrays with align8, pointCount+4 int safety, each multiply/add/align and total<=INT_MAX accounting limit.
limits.wasmCapacity: Input bytes + align8(input bytes) + exact core work bytes + output 8 bytes <= emscripten_get_heap_max(); current heap ranges validated before reading. Necessary address-space condition, not free-memory promise.
limits.hostCapacity: Same checked formula with SIZE_MAX address limit and INT_MAX core-accounting/workspace cap.
limits.allocations: Bridge scratch malloc may return ALLOCATION before world mutation. Core final hull, world database clone/map and body/shape allocations retain assert/trap semantics; no all-OOM recovery claim.

hullCooking.containment: All points vs final builder planes before origin restoration using identical core b3PlaneSeparation and exact minOutside; equality accepted, next representable value above rejected. Then final restored planes checked against original copied points with same bound. No added epsilon.
hullCooking.memory: Point scratch and exact workspace in one per-world tracked temporary allocation. Core cooked hull always destroyed on normal exit. No native hull pointer or borrowed buffer escapes; world clones/interns on success.

validation.behavior: Same real cook, topology and all-input containment path as create; releases all temporary resources on ordinary return. Never creates a body or shape. World only supplies lock and tracked temporary ownership. Does not preflight body-specific mass/inertia aggregation.
validation.success: Status0 validates geometry only; no world/body mutation and no cached native hull survives.
validation.capacity: Uses the same creation scratch planner, including its 8-byte wire-result reservation, so disabled admission matches create capacity.
validation.failure: Known statuses1,2,4,5,8,9 are prewrite refusals. Unexpected status3/native trap is UNKNOWN and must fault the facade world; cleanup after trap is not promised.

fixedJointBridge.id: two uint32 low/high via official b3Store/LoadJointId; exact world and both live body capabilities required
fixedJointBridge.creation: native weld captures current body-origin relative pose without writes; common frame orientation=current originA rotation; position=sole dynamic endpoint world COM, otherwise midpoint of both world COMs; local frames=inverse(current body origin)*common world frame
fixedJointBridge.configuration: collideConnected exact bool; breakForce finite nonnegative f32 N; breakTorque finite nonnegative f32 N*m; changing thresholds/collision does not recapture frames
fixedJointBridge.events: separate copied count:u32 + count * [joint.low/high:u32, valid:u32]; facade copies immediately after step before callbacks/mutations; no native pointers or userdata
fixedJointBridge.breakSemantics: native reports threshold met/exceeded during solver bias substeps but never auto destroys; observation omits force/torque magnitude; adapter latches and safe-destroys explicitly
fixedJointBridge.lifetime: all reads copied; native events invalidated by next step/destruction. Body/world destruction invalidates joint capability. No pointer/generation truncation.

hingeJointBridge.autoPivotB: bool: capture current world anchor of A in B instead of pivotB; Cocos null connectedBody uses this
hingeJointBridge.frames: local +Z maps to normalized axisA. Initial world orientations equal establish zero. No body pose writes. Explicit geometry changes recreate at safe commit; config-only updates preserve frames. Spring remains disabled.
hingeJointBridge.admission: Exact counts, booleans, copied finite fields, nonzero axis, distinct valid full-generation endpoints in exact world. Raw bounds ordered and within +/-0.99f*B3_PI even when disabled, never silently clamped or sorted. All validation before first mutation; bad output capacity untouched.
hingeJointBridge.publicConvention: Derived documented Box3D coordinate decision: A-relative-B angle, degrees and degrees/second; native speed=-publicSpeed*pi/180, native bounds=[-publicUpper,-publicLower]*pi/180. Original C30 literal positive native target retained with clarification, not silently rewritten.
hingeJointBridge.lifetime: Copied state only, owned joint capability; generic joint destruction. Body/world destruction invalidates joint. No invented Cocos spring/break event.

reactionTorqueReadback.actsOn: body B; A receives opposite angular couple
reactionTorqueReadback.temporalScope: Current retained solver impulse/basis cache times latest world inv_h. Configuration may clear terms; sleeping cache may be rescaled without a solve. Not a live load, historical frozen sample or outer-step average.
reactionTorqueReadback.excludes: linear constraint force lever-arm r cross F about body COM
reactionTorqueReadback.implementation: Read-only pinned b3RevoluteJoint final perpImpulse/perpAxisX/perpAxisY plus spring+motor+lower-upper impulse along rotationAxisZ, exactly once, times world.inv_h. Never call upstream b3GetRevoluteJointTorque.
reactionTorqueReadback.guards: Existing full joint/world generation/type and unlocked-world guards; fixed core source SHA and patch-chain audit; compiled field-size assertions; native fixture verifies unchanged solver/body bytes.

pointToPointJointBridge.geometry: pivotA.xyz, pivotB.xyz in body-origin admitted-scale local metres; finite float32
pointToPointJointBridge.autoPivotB: exact bool; capture current A world pivot in B instead of pivotB; no body pose writes
pointToPointJointBridge.configuration: collideConnected exact bool; collision-only configure does not recapture anchors
pointToPointJointBridge.angularFreedom: Native spherical spring, motor, cone and twist limits disabled; native default positional softness retained. No reaction force/torque/angle diagnostic exposed.
pointToPointJointBridge.lifetime: Owned full-generation exact-world joint capability, copied state; generic destroy; joint-before-owned-static-anchor cleanup. Public explicit pivot setter with nullB recaptures current world anchor at next safe commit, including identical values; collision-only updates preserve capture.

convexQueries.points: copied world-oriented XYZ relative to supplied origin; convex hull plus nonnegative radius
convexQueries.filter: bilateral uint32 category/mask zero-extended to native64; trigger filtering continues traversal
convexQueries.capacity: count-only then full capacity verified before output; no persistent allocation or implicit hit cap
convexQueries.ownership: unlocked exact world; all four pointer regions aligned and nonoverlapping; complete full shape IDs copied, never ownership capabilities
convexQueries.zero: zero cast translation avoids core and facade native call; overlap remains a separate query
convexQueries.initialOverlap: native conservative overlap (including distance slop), not MTD or permission to move; inside cast fraction0 preserved
convexQueries.epoch: facade committed stepIndex/mutationRevision copied; queries do not mutate them
convexQueries.public: six primitive Cocos sweeps plus exact live before-step context copied whole-group queries; no mutation guard relaxation

staticMeshResource.resourceToken: two uint32 words monotonic within exact WASM binding; facade brands each separately owned cache lease
staticMeshResource.worldScope: exact full world ID; no cross-world native data sharing
staticMeshResource.cook: copied body-local float32 XYZ / int32 triangle list; CCW normalized once; no welding; SAH/adjacency; reject degenerate and duplicate oriented indices
staticMeshResource.lifetime: cache leases and native shape borrows separately counted; free once after both zero; world destroys core shapes before freeing data
staticMeshResource.lifetimeCounterScope: ST module cumulative uint64; b3CreateMesh nonnull returns and completed b3DestroyMesh calls including rollback; not allocator free counts; no reset/tombstone/pointer; separate liveBytes baseline required; exclusive fixture takes deltas
staticMeshResource.lifetimeCounterOverflow: cook refuses CAPACITY before native creation at UINT64_MAX or sticky overflow; destroy always proceeds and sets sticky on overflow; snapshot returns CAPACITY without output write if sticky
staticMeshResource.sourceFace: read cooked triangle index -> original flattened source ordinal; preserve existing query 11-word cooked index ABI
staticMeshResource.admission: static only; nonstatic create or SetType rejected before native mutation; sensor/contact not qualified
staticMeshResource.copiedDebug: actual cooked triangle edges; bounded debug allocation, no Hull substitution

rules.safety: ST serialized read at ready committed safe point. Native validates full world ID and explicit locked/active task state before GetCounters; every failure leaves all caller output unchanged. No allocation, step, flush, trim, draw or mutation.
rules.capacityLedger: Exact pinned b3GetWorldByteCount ledger, including embedded tree sizeof terms. Not a complete malloc ledger. Sum of every row must equal GetCounters.byteCount. No residual, unknown-as-zero or partial success.
rules.integers: Checked uint64 arithmetic; core int-sized intermediate groups are preflighted before core GetCounters. Overflow or inconsistent accounting returns non-OK.
rules.globals: b3GetByteCount requested-size accounting and actual native air_b3_bridge_memory(0) are separate scopes. Never add them to worldLedger as a total.
rules.stepIndex: Native completed-step identity only, not an epoch of every allocation/mutation. Binding revision/generation are separate labels.
rules.workload: b3World_GetMaxCapacity is a step-sampled historical workload maximum, not allocation capacity, a budget or an acceptance threshold.
rules.workerArena: Backing capacity read independently from taskContexts[].arena.capacity; excluded from worldLedger, distinct from Counters.arenaCapacity peakDemand.
rules.mesh: Successful cook/completed destroy counts are module-wide call counters including rollback. Per-resource leases/borrows are separate existing backend snapshots, not a module-wide census.
rules.afterClose: Unavailable through this live-world backend method. No retained/replacement factory, module or new host is introduced.

emptyWorldStorage.success: Same world object and ID, step/end-buffer role/config/history preserved; ACK invalidates all borrowed native views and retires all event buffers. Capacity restored from creationCapacity; F=H. No implicit Step.
emptyWorldStorage.nonempty: Status14 only: no event ACK, no mutation, no baseline claim
emptyWorldStorage.ownership: Serialized ready owner, all callbacks/tasks joined, all external views retired, no bridge temporary/debug/resource ownership. Backend additionally proves resource leases and pending event/snapshot state settled.
emptyWorldStorage.errors: All returned refusals preflight before mutation; unexpected host exception is unknown and faults backend. Allocation failure is process-fatal, not a recoverable rollback.
emptyWorldStorage.identity: Four-family same-world high/floor with checked exhaustion. Not cross-world raw ID ABA protection.
emptyWorldStorage.baseline: Current implementation initial world ledger includes fixed identityHistory and creationCapacity metadata. Never substitute historical36040 or rewrite acceptance.
